title: Whirlpool WED87HED
contents_raw:
== Background ==

Released in 2014, the Whirlpool Duet Steam WED87HED front-load electric dryer is equipped with high-efficiency SensorDrying technology and was the first clothes dryer to earn an Energy Star qualification.

== Technical Specifications ==

***Width:*** 27 Inch

***Depth:*** 31 Inch

***Height:*** 39 Inch

***Weight:*** 150 Lbs.

***Capacity:*** 7.4 Cu. Ft.

***Drum Material:*** Powder Coat

***Heating Burner Power:*** 20,000 BTU

***Electrical Requirements:*** 240V/30A

== Identification ==

The model number can be found inside the door around the drum.

== Additional Information ==

* [link|https://www.whirlpool.com/owners.html|Whirlpool Owner's Manuals]
